changelog: Transparent Navigation Bar now lets the live page extend behind navigation icons instead of revealing an empty black strip.
Scrolling keeps final items reachable, with bottom controls clear of the navigation bar.
Turning transparency off restores the original layout. Navigation icons, labels and gesture insets are preserved.
ATTENTION: Update and fully restart CloudStream. Use Transparent Navigation Bar under Navigation settings.
Plain page backgrounds stay plain; this option does not add artwork or artificial blur.
